name: JSON Schema Governance and Protocol Spine
description: Establish centralized schema governance with standardized conventions, shared definitions, automated validation, and TypeScript type generation. Established by ADR 0020. This campaign should not close until the control-plane entities, roadmap records, authority receipts, runtime events, extension manifests, migrations, and compatibility rules all use the registry rather than local or duplicated validators.
objective: All schemas conform to JSON Schema 2020-12. Central registry maintained. CI validates and generates TypeScript types. Protocol spine extracted as @tribunus/protocol package.
